description: Pydantic AI agent run with one tool call, traced by Pydantic AI's own OpenTelemetry support with message content.
notes: Agent.instrument_all sets Pydantic AI's instrumentation to the harness provider with include_content on. The model is OpenAIChatModel pointed at the mock. The tree is invoke_agent [agent], then chat [llm], execute_tool get_weather [tool], and chat [llm] again. The agent span's input is pydantic_ai.all_messages and its output is final_result. Each llm span's input and output are gen_ai.input.messages and gen_ai.output.messages. Tool call tool_call_response parts carry result, not response. gen_ai.agent.call.id and gen_ai.conversation.id are UUIDv7 values that change per run and are listed as volatile. No telemetry leaves the process: the mock is the only host.
